description: List a user's personal agents (assistants). Each agent has its own calendar (list_calendar_events with agent_id) and todo list (list_todos with agent_id). With user_id: that user's agents. Without: when you act as an agent, your team (all agents of your owner); otherwise your own agents, or — if you own none — all agents of the tenant. An empty result therefore really means there are none.
name: list_agents
